endpoint: GET https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?state=all&sort=created&direction=desc&per_page=100 (GitHub REST API), paged by the Link header
capture: Constructed in the documented pull request list shape; the same pull requests appear in gh-pr-list.json in the form the existing forge snapshot command reads through gh. Not captured from a live repository, since no delivery lane holds a provider token.
redactions: None needed: the organisation, repository, pull requests and hashes are invented.
